typographie_suggestion.explanation: The typeface features the high contrast between thick and thin strokes, vertical stress, and small, unbracketed (hairline) serifs characteristic of the late 18th and early 19th-century "Modern" style (similar to Bodoni or Didot), which was standard for French academic printing of that era.
